# dokploy_registry (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dokploy_registry" "ghcr" {
  name           = "github-registry"
  username       = "myuser"
  password       = "ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  image_registry = "ghcr"
}

resource "dokploy_registry" "dockerhub" {
  name           = "docker-hub"
  username       = "myuser"
  password       = "dckr_xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  image_registry = "dockerhub"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image_registry` (String) Type of registry: 'ghcr', 'dockerhub', 'ecr', 'digitalocean', 'google', 'gitlab', 'azure', 'self-hosted'
- `name` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `username` (String)

### Optional

- `registry_url` (String) Required if image_registry is 'self-hosted' or custom

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
